title: Hungary's parliament votes to reverse anti-LGBTQ legislation from Orban era
summary: Hungary's parliament passed a bill amending the 2021 "child protection law." The move is considered the first significant reversal of Orban's curbs targeting the LGBTQ+ community.

image.caption: Orban's government had gradually curbed LGBTQ+ rightsImage: Anna Szilagyi/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: Hungary's parliament on Tuesday passed a bill amending a 2021 law targeting the LGBTQ+ community that was passed under nationalist ex-leader Viktor Orban.
The 2021 "child protection" law introduced restrictions on the "portrayal" or "promotion" of sexual and gender diversity in content accessible to children.
